correctness.rationale: Independently re-enumerated all 2^10 one-per-complementary-pair families on [6] and grouped by brute-force canonical min-image over all 720 perms of S6: exactly 13 orbits with total 1024, orbit-stabilizer identity holding per class, stabilizer orders {120,12,4,36,12,8,4,120,4,8,6,36,60} and orbit sizes {6,60,180,20,60,90,180,6,180,90,120,20,12} matching DRAFT/census.json byte-for-byte. Verified each rep has size 10, is pairwise intersecting, takes exactly one per complementary pair (hence maximum; the n=2k pigeonhole bound is classical and correctly not claimed new), canonical forms pairwise distinct, shifted-status (only star fixed under all Frankl ij-shifts), star==row 0 and triangle==row 3, coarse keys (degree seq, intersection profile, stab) pairwise distinct with #10/#11 separated by stab 6 vs 36, Katona max exactly 3 on all 60 circles for every rep, and DRAFT table reps identical to census.json reps. Verifier replays VERIFY_OK. This is a complete finite machine-checked proof, not mere experimental evidence; the complementary-pair maximality argument plus orbit-sum closure is a full completeness proof.

originality.rationale: Substantive comparison, not timestamp: EKR (1961) gives only size 10=(1/2)C(6,3) at n=2k with every transversal extremal, so it proves non-uniqueness and does not imply N. Frankl-Furedi arXiv:1108.2179 abstract explicitly limits uniqueness to n>2k, confirming the degeneracy gap. Hilton-Milner requires n>2k and is inapplicable. OEIS A325982 verified live to record HM sizes for n>2k only (row n=6 has only k=0,1,2 entries 1,1,3; k=3 first appears at n=7 with value 13) with no iso-type census. McKenna 2005 (doi:10.37236/1964) proves only boundedness f(k,m)<=f(k), not the exact N=13 with representatives/stabilizers/shifting-status. Live arXiv full-text search for maximum-intersecting (6,3) isomorphism census returned no results; OEIS search on orbit-size signature returned no results. No prior source records N=13 or the 13 representatives. The route (complementary-pair choice + canonical rejection) replaces blocked shifting-compression and is not a rename or parameter substitution.

value.rationale: Headline is a complete exact invariant census, judged separately from any survey: N=13 S6-orbits of 10-set maximum intersecting 3-families on [6] with one representative, orbit size, stabilizer order, and shifting-status per type plus replayable maximality/non-isomorphism certificates. Object (smallest EKR n=2k degeneracy) and invariant (isomorphism-type count) were motivated before computation by EKR non-uniqueness boundary and McKenna iso-class program; value 13 is not known or mechanically implied by size bound 10; a future researcher (stability base case, McKenna-type programs, canonical-form test instances) could reasonably need the precise table. Orbit sizes summing to 1024 certify completeness, so no incomplete-census discount applies. Not a textbook restatement (size 10 explicitly disclaimed), not a mere substitution, not a tiny unmotivated gain, not an unexplained enumeration (every type has witness + certificates + distinguishing invariants). Eligible as a narrow exact datum under the stated standard.

decisive_checks: Independent stdlib re-enumeration of 1024 transversals: all intersecting, exactly 13 canonical orbits, orbit counts match claimed orbit sizes, sum 1024.
Per-class stabilizer brute force over 720 perms matches claimed stabs; orbit-stabilizer 720/stab==orbit holds.
census.json canon fields match recomputed canonical min-images; 13 canons pairwise distinct; DRAFT table reps equal census.json reps row-for-row.
Frankl ij-shift recomputation: only row 0 (star) shifted; star canon==row 0, triangle canon==row 3.
Coarse invariants (sorted degree seq, pairwise-intersection multiset, stab) pairwise distinct across 13 types; #10/#11 share deg/inter but stab 6 vs 36.
Katona recomputation over all 60 circle systems: max<=3 and attained (=3) for every rep.
Verifier output/artifacts/verify.py replays VERIFY_OK from census.json alone.
residual_risks: Literature search is bounded, not exhaustive; an obscure thesis could in principle list the same 13 types, but cited formula-level priors provably do not imply N and live database/arxiv checks are negative.

Katona <=3 recheck is a weak independent consistency check, not the completeness proof; completeness rests on the complementary-pair one-per-pair argument plus orbit-sum 1024, which is correct for n=2k,k=3.
Shifting-status is order-relative (natural order 1<...<6) as disclosed; complement maps counted via S6 relabeling as disclosed.
